problems: judge: Overstates causality by saying exercise 'helped restore' mitochondrial cleanup, whereas abstract only reports association.

sentences.text: Researchers used an animal model of stroke involving male mice to compare three groups: those undergoing sham surgery, those with induced strokes, and those with induced strokes plus treadmill exercise. Scientists measured motor performance using a standard neurological scoring test to assess recovery.

Mice that exercised demonstrated better recovery of movement skills than those that did not, as the activity helped restore a specific cellular cleanup process for mitochondria. The authors suggest these cellular changes might help keep mitochondrial function stable after a stroke, though these findings apply only to the animal model.

judge.reason: Overstates causality by saying exercise 'helped restore' mitochondrial cleanup, whereas abstract only reports association.
